items.Sentence: The Facility headworks are located at Plant 1 and 2.
Plant 1 is equipped with influent pumps and a mechanical screen... Plant 2 contains additional mechanical screens.
The Emergency Storage Lagoon can be used... to capture peak flows in excess of the Facility’s peak design capacity... This flow can be routed back to the Facility headworks for treatment...
The Facility’s secondary treatment system consists of three parallel trains of oxidation ditches with anoxic basins...
The Facility’s secondary treatment system consists of three parallel trains of oxidation ditches with anoxic basins, followed by secondary clarifiers.
Secondary effluent is treated using sand filters...
Secondary effluent is... disinfected via ultraviolet light prior to discharge...
Sludge handling... consists of an aerated clay-lined pond (referred to as an aerobic digester)...
Sludge handling... consists of... three clay lined sludge lagoons...
Sludge handling... consists of... three belt filter presses...
Sludge handling... consists of... four greenhouse solar drying beds.
Biosolids are stored on site... and are hauled to a local landfill once per year.
